peerqa_scoring.primary: Token F1 against the authors' free-form answer, only on the 181 questions that have one (107 of 288 have none)
peerqa_scoring.sensitivity: Token F1 against PeerQA's released generated answers (qa-augmented-answers.jsonl), all 288 questions; labelled LLM-written references
peerqa_scoring.retrieval_measures: CEC and context tokens on all 288 questions

human_review.design: 34 C-INT questions x 3 NEW conditions (one per RQ6 LLM: llama3.2:3b, qwen2.5:0.5b, phi4-mini); questions drawn with seed 42 stratified by question type, after the run, before anyone reads the answers
human_review.blinding: model and system labels hidden; answer order shuffled with seed 42; three sheets, one answer per question each, completed in separate sittings; mapping kept in a restricted file; reattribution by exact answer text (as in the RQ5 correction)
human_review.labels: the 6-label RQ5 rubric (SUPPORTED, PARTIAL, UNSUPPORTED, CONTRADICTED, REFUSAL_VALID, UNJUSTIFIED_REFUSAL)
human_review.second_reviewer: 20 of the 102 (seeded), if a group member is available; otherwise reported as single-reviewer
human_review.agreement: raw percent agreement; Cohen kappa on 6 labels (unstable at n=20); kappa on supported vs not supported
